svg.title: Benchmark baseline
svg.desc: Strip plot of per-run throughput for eleven workloads, core and replay.
svg.text: Benchmark baseline, v2.0.0: every run, all eleven workloads
Throughput of each run of 100,000 timed commands, 90 runs per row (3 sessions × 30). Each dot is one run; the bar is the median.
Recorded 2026-10-29 on the same machine (Ryzen 5 5600G, MSVC Release), after optimization and the order behaviors. Higher is faster.
replay: the same commands as in-memory CSV through the replay engine
The v1 workloads run 1.5–1.8× their first baseline on core and 2.0–2.4× on replay (docs/OPTIMIZATION.md).
The behavior workloads' replay rows are slower: twelve-column v2 rows, and more events per command to collect.
